description: A burr of white fur bristling every way, blue in its shadows. Warm to wear, and slow to finish thawing.
lore: It comes off thorn scrub and fence wire on the passes, wherever the white things have gone through — [[monsters/ice_wolf|Winterfang]] leaves it by the handful and never comes back for it. The seller at the north market has one rule and will not sell to anyone who breaks it: take a tuft bare-handed and hold it until it stops being cold. That is about a minute. The cold comes out of it into you first, all of it, before any warmth arrives, and a man who sews a hood full of it without knowing that gets an hour on the road worse than no hood at all — which is precisely the hour a cold man decides to sit down and rest a moment. Twenty gold. Half the young crackers think the minute is theatre. He lets them think so, and he still will not sell to one who lets go early.
gm_notes: The warmest material in the country charges its price up front. The seller's rule is a bereavement he does not explain; leave it unexplained.
